title: User Interface Advanced Concepts
description: Master advanced UI design patterns, responsive layouts, accessibility, and dynamic interfaces in PEGA
objectives: Design responsive layouts that adapt to multiple devices
Create dynamic interfaces with conditional UI
Master skin rules and CSS frameworks
Build reusable UI components and templates

content.introduction: Advanced UI concepts in PEGA go beyond basic forms and layouts. This lesson covers responsive design, accessibility, dynamic interfaces, and reusable components that create exceptional user experiences.

sections.title: Responsive Design Principles
sections.content: Modern applications must work seamlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. PEGA's responsive design capabilities allow you to create layouts that automatically adapt to different screen sizes and orientations.

sections.title: Accessibility Standards
sections.content: WCAG 2.1 compliance ensures your application is usable by people with disabilities. Key areas include keyboard navigation, screen reader support, color contrast, and focus management.
list: ARIA labels and roles for screen readers
Alternative text for images and icons

sections.title: Dynamic Interfaces
sections.content: Create interfaces that respond to user actions and data changes without page reloads. Use visibility conditions, refresh actions, and dynamic layouts.
sections.example: A loan application form that shows additional fields based on loan type selection, with real-time validation and progress indicators.

sections.title: Skin Rules and CSS
sections.content: Master PEGA's skin rules to create consistent, branded interfaces. Understand CSS inheritance, custom styles, and theme overrides.
bestPractices: Use CSS variables for consistent theming
Create reusable CSS classes for common patterns
Optimize for performance with efficient selectors

sections.title: Reusable Components
sections.content: Build modular UI components that can be reused across multiple sections and applications. Create templates for common patterns like navigation, forms, and data displays.
